messages:
deploy-bot: Initiated deploy of tag `v1.15.3-hotfix-embed-load` to production

deploy-bot: target=production, commits=3f2b1a8 -> b7c9d02, strategy=canary(1/5), initiated_by @hannah

hannah (eng-runtime): quick hotfix that changes the model load path for embeddings worker to handle older drivers. should be small and no API changes.

marc (sre): watching canary pool now, tailing logs from embed-canary-7

deploy-bot: Canary host embed-canary-7 -> starting containers

marc (sre): embed-canary-7 logs: `ERROR: Failed to mmap model file: Invalid argument` then process exits. seeing ~2% 502s routed to that host.

jasper (platform): halt the rollout. don't promote further canaries until we validate startup across driver versions. propose pinning traffic back to v1.15.2 for safety.

hannah (eng-runtime): ack. i'll pull the canary out and build a debug image with verbose loader logs. opened PR #4523 with the debug image.

deploy-bot: Canary 1 -> failed (startup crash). Automated rollout paused.

luis (devops): applying immediate pause + pin: `kubectl patch deployment embeddings --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"redwood/embeddings:v1.15.2"}]'` — applied.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback complete for embed-canary-7. Production pools remain on v1.15.2. No global rollback required.

samantha (product): CS reports a few customers saw transient 502s. severity low, but notifying the affected customers.

marc (sre): other health checks green. creating incident INC-4333 and assigning to @hannah for root cause & timeline.

hannah (eng-runtime): thanks — i'll reproduce on older driver matrix, add a driver-gating check to startup, and add a CI smoke step for embeddings startup on the matrix. will follow up with a safe re-release PR.

jasper (platform): note for next sprint: require pre-traffic startup smoke and consider increasing canary cohort to 2 hosts for hotfixes touching load paths.

deploy-bot: Created deploy record: https://deploys.redwood.ai/prod/1763605000 - status=paused - initiator=hannah

samantha (product): appreciate the quick pause. i'll update the release notes and CS thread to reflect this.

deploy-bot: Thread closed (no further automated actions).
